name: Euston-8B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B: 36 full GQA layers (kv heads 8, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. An RL fine-tune (GRPO against a rule-based boxed-answer reward, no judge model) of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.0B parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes same-table evidence against its own base. Two caveats the card states itself and which the rows carry: a large part of the 34.25 pp balanced-accuracy gap is the base failing to emit a parseable verdict at all (38.0% of items truncated) rather than worse judgement - the card attributes ~18 pp to learning to terminate and 16.3 pp to judgement - and the model regresses on AIME 2026 (69.17 -> 65.00 official semantics, card calls it not significant). It is a discrimination score on mathematical claim verification, not general capability. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-19.

benchmarks.name: Balanced accuracy, balanced held-out split
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Metric | DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B | Euston |'; base 29.50%. 200 true + 200 false statements, one pair per source paper, temporally disjoint from training. Base's 29.50 is below chance because 38.0% of its answers were unparseable within the token budget and scored wrong.

benchmarks.name: Pairwise adjudication score, all 200 pairs
benchmarks.config: Same card's 'Pairwise adjudication' table; base 48.0%. Ties credited 0.5. Coverage 41% vs 21%; accuracy within coverage 84.1% vs 40.5% (conditional figure).

benchmarks.name: Discrimination gap P(false|false)-P(false|true) (pp)
benchmarks.config: Same table; base -0.5 pp (z = -0.1), Euston +27.5 pp (z = +6.0). Printed as a percentage-point gap. Stored on a 100 scale as percentage points; the metric ranges -100..100, not 0..100.

benchmarks.name: AIME 2026, official semantics
benchmarks.config: Card 'Capability retention, AIME 2026' table; base 69.17% - LOSS of 4.17 pp, 95% CI [-10.83, +2.50], card calls it not significant. 30 problems, 4 samples. Recorded as printed.

benchmarks.name: AIME 2026, landed runs only
benchmarks.config: Same table; base 89.51% - LOSS of 12.96 pp, significant. Recorded as printed.
